boardRow.name: The Hill Mine
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Terraced steamworks ground above a rail cut and flooded gallery.

goals: Build across the terraces and keep watch on the rail cut.
Railhead Escort: see the ore cart safely across for a town payout.
rules: T2 and T3 pads out-range the valley, but cliff faces block bolts.
Claim-jumpers must climb the switchbacks; cliff bands are impassable.
The flooded gallery is deep except at the trestle and wet edge.
Coal seams lie at the mine mouth on the top terrace, north of the boiler-house site.
briefing.geographyLine: A terraced hillside mine above a flooded rail cut.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar is on the spur. Keep the cut open.
baron.defeatBeat: Boiler cold, wheels locked, the town can graduate into steam.
